svg.title: 039 fog comparison / Reader
svg.desc: Fog treatments are columns, best-ranked first. Each labeled row shares one fixture and viewpoint. Half-resolution ground rasters. Story revelations through page 039.
svg.text: FOG-OF-WAR STUDIES — NOT ADOPTED / COLUMNS W3, W2, W1 / OPEN AT FULL SIZE / REVELATIONS THROUGH 039

svg.title: Patchy contest — 039 / Before the weights reveal — Reader
svg.desc: Fog of war, Patchy contest: 039 / Before the weights reveal, Reader. Schematic drawn claim terrain; P1 hatched; P2 hatched; P3 dark; P4 dark; P5 hatched. P1 outer foothold hatched. Observation islands: response hatched, correction hatched, configuration hatched, weights dark, staging hatched. P6 remains dark and unreachable. Dark means no available support, not false. Contours remain fixed across fixtures. Design sample, not adopted. Shaded relief with a soft, irregular fog edge; unexplored ground is opaque, ground that lost support stays dimly visible. Many pictograms lie draped on the ground beneath the fog, not text; a key names them outside the map.
svg.text: ONE FORM OF EACH FAMILY SHOWN / ALL LIE UNDER THE FOG
THE WIPE SUPPORTS AN INDEPENDENCE READING. THE READING IS STILL INFERENCE.
032.5; 035.4; 038.5 / recurrence documented; independence inferred · OUR INFERENCE / SCHEMATIC RELIEF / FOG IS COMPUTED, NOT MEASURED
